_comment: Copy to .agents/repo-map.config.json and adjust the paths for your machine.
The real config is gitignored because paths are per-developer, not project facts.
And:   /add-dir <repo path>   so the agent can read the source the map points at.

spdk._why: Every lvstore/blobstore abort RCA starts here. 'Forcing application shutdown via abort' -> lib/lvol/lvol.c:2945, 'Extent page crc mismmatch' -> lib/blob/blobstore.c:5990.

ultra._why: The distrib layer. 'DISTRIBD Unable to read stripe' -> DISTR_v2/src_code_app_spdk/bdev_distrib/parts/alg_io_split_parity2.cpp:226.

operator._why: Contains the CSI driver, which owns the nvme connect string: ctrl_loss_tmo, keep-alive-tmo, fast_io_fail_tmo. Several client-side findings trace back to values set here.

sbcli-core._why: The control plane in this repo. 'port fence held {}s' -> storage_node_ops.py:10312, 'already shutting down in this cluster' -> storage_node_ops.py:6900.
